title: CLsat loci in Darevskia genomes (revision panel)

notes.ortho: Positional orthology from flanking sequence: flanks of 600 / 3,000 / 5,000 letters (a longer flank only where the shorter one was unresolved; never past the middle of the gap to the next locus); tandem-repeat letters (TRF) masked; satellite pieces and pieces >=100 letters with another copy in the own genome masked (N); every anchor flank single copy in its own genome (>=80% identity); a pair = clear best hit in the target assembly (second < 0.9 x best bits), both ways, >=80% identity over >=200 letters. "Orthologous to" lists these pairs only: distinct partner assemblies, then partner loci.
notes.flag: 10 catalogue loci annotated by arbitration, plus the 4 uncatalogued candidates (not catalogue members). Only 2 are a seed/rescan contradiction (the rescan scored another family >=20 bits above the seed; the seed family is retained). The rest are close-margin calls (segment or seed-conflict resolved with a margin below 15 bits) or loci without a seed.
notes.full: Every locus (594, all 6 assemblies) with its sub-subfamily call and both flanks' class. Ortholog = a decided pair (rule in the Orthologous loci tab); the L/R partner columns show the best raw hit of each flank as evidence.
